title: HW↔FE-001: Hardware Health Signals + Device-Health Dashboard Requirements (DERIVED)
description: DERIVED / PROVISIONAL — there is NO direct §6 contract on either the Hardware Engineer or the Frontend/Dashboard Engineer side (HARDWARE_ENGINEER_SKILL §6 lists no Frontend; FRONTEND_DASHBOARD_ENGINEER_SKILL §6 lists no Hardware Engineer). Hardware-status visualization is mediated end-to-end: device-health signals are emitted by Firmware as telemetry (HW↔FW-001), carried to the cloud (FW↔BACK-001), served to the dashboard (BACK↔FE-001), with serving views via DATA↔FE-001. This schema reconstructs the plausible direct interface (hardware-health signal definitions ↔ device-health dashboard requirements) for machine validation; per its x-macp.source_status it mandates a COUNTER. No alert thresholds or signal ranges are invented.

hardware_health_signals.description: HW→FE: device-health signal definitions (surfaced via the FW→BACK→FE telemetry path).

unit.description: Explicit unit per physical signal, e.g., V, mA, °C; use 'enum'/'bool' for status signals.

x-macp.tier_rationale: Provisional/DERIVED edge — no §6 contract exists on either side; hardware-status visualization is mediated through Firmware telemetry → Backend API → Frontend. Agents coordinate provisionally and must COUNTER for ratification.
x-macp.source_status: DERIVED — no direct §6 on either the HW or FE side; reconstructed from the mediated path (HW↔FW-001 / FW↔BACK-001 / BACK↔FE-001 / DATA↔FE-001). Mandates COUNTER (CCR to ratify a §6 contract), not a binding CONFIRM.
x-macp.cadence: TRIGGER (provisional — to be set by the ratifying §6 contract / CCR)
confirm_conditions: every physical health signal carries an explicit unit
device-health signals are routed via the Firmware telemetry path (HW↔FW-001 → FW↔BACK-001 → BACK↔FE-001)
no alert threshold is invented absent operator/field validation
reject_conditions: a physical health signal emitted without a unit (units rule §3.10)
a direct hardware→frontend feed proposed that bypasses Firmware telemetry / the Backend API (architecture path)
this DERIVED schema treated as a binding contract — it is provisional pending §6 ratification
counter_conditions: ALWAYS COUNTER: request ratification of a real HW↔FE §6 contract (or confirm the relationship is intentionally mediated) via a CCR before any binding CONFIRM
a dashboard signal has no telemetry source — request the Firmware telemetry field (HW↔FW-001 / FW↔DATA-001) before building the view
